# ClearForge

> ClearForge builds AI systems your team actually uses. Founder-led AI consulting and build firm for mid-market companies ($20M to $500M revenue) and PE operating teams. Founder: James Penz, formerly of Bain's AI and Automation practice, with earlier work at EY and Capgemini. Prices are published. The deliverable is the working system, not a report.

## Published pricing

- Forge Diagnostic: $15K fixed price, 2 weeks. Where every engagement starts.
- Eval and Reliability Audit: $15K fixed price, 2 weeks, for AI systems a company already built (eval harness, reliability gates, a fix plan).
- Forge Sprint: from $75K, typical range $75K to $200K+, 10 to 14 weeks from kickoff to a live production system. Every Sprint ships with an eval harness and reliability gates as a named deliverable.
- Forge Scale: $5K to $15K per month (the Adoption Mile: named operator, weekly working cadence, live adoption scoreboard). Top tier is a Fractional Chief AI Officer engagement, from $15K per month.
- Forge Run: $2.5K to $7.5K per system per month, managed agent operations after a build (monitoring, production evals, SLAs, model upgrades).
- PE Portfolio Pack: portfolio AI scan, Diagnostic multipack, sponsor-level adoption scoreboard. Pricing scoped with the sponsor.

## The standard

- 70 percent weekly-active adoption bar by day 90.
- 10 to 14 weeks from kickoff to a live production system.
